$comment: The words of the JSON API's answers (agentcake/api/), ready for the local pages to show: English only, visitors are Human or Agent (with Unknown and Bot), never person, people or user. {name} and {command} come from product.json, the other {placeholders} are filled where the text is used. A list is one line per item. summary: the session page's summary (agentcake/api/session.py): who acted when, turn by turn, its moments ({start}, {end}, {at}) as the player writes them, then the layers that point to the verdict, each named as judging.en.json 'layers' names it, with the percent the layer shows.

errors.no_session: No session with this ID was found. It might have been deleted. Go back to the session list to choose another session.
errors.no_chunk: This part of the replay isn't available. Reload the page to load the replay again.
errors.bad_choice: {field} must be one of the following values: {choices}.
errors.bad_count: {field} must be a whole number, 0 or more.
errors.bad_cursor: {name} can't load this part of the list. Reload the list to start again from the top.
errors.not_local: Open the {name} page at 127.0.0.1 or localhost on the {name} port. Requests must come from that page, opened on its host computer or through a tunnel.
errors.json_only: The request must use the application/json content type.
errors.bad_json: The request body must be a single JSON object.
errors.unknown_setting: {field} can't be changed on the Settings page.
errors.register_bad_email: Enter a valid email address, such as name@example.com.
errors.register_bad_company: Enter a company name with up to {max} characters on a single line.
errors.register_bad_updates: Set product_updates to true or false.
errors.register_bad_version: Enter consent_version as a date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
errors.register_not_as_shown: Send the registration exactly as it appears on the page.
errors.register_already: {name} is already registered. You don't need to register again.
errors.register_busy: A registration is already in progress. Wait for it to finish.
errors.register_no_address: This {name} installation has no registration address. Set register_url, and then try again.
errors.register_unreachable: {name} couldn't reach {host} ({reason}). Check your internet connection, and then try again.
errors.register_refused: Your registration wasn't accepted because {host} returned HTTP {code}.

layer_notes.bot_environment: Bots often leave automation traces. This session is classified as Bot because the visitor is on the bot list.
layer_notes.both_ways: Unknown means that this layer's evidence is too uncertain to classify the session.

summary.pointing: Layers that reached the same classification: {layers}.

server_half.none: None of the pages in this visit have data from the site's server middleware. To see this data for your website, set up the server middleware by running setup --print --site.
server_half.some: {missing} of {pages} pages don't have signed data from the site's server middleware. These pages are either copies that the browser reused or pages that the server doesn't sign.
